note: Item-level inventory with origin project names and local import paths is not published. Local imports stay on disk under imported-skills/ (gitignored). Reusable knowledge is in the canonical creative and dev skills.

rules.depreciado: an active canonical skill has the same id
rules.bloqueado: declared license unknown, a third-party license without copyright notice or attribution, or secret-like content, private files, links or special files in the package
rules.não verificado: everything else: license evidence, gate gaps, external tools and a human reading are still missing
rules.revisado: never derived: requires a human reading of the instructions, a passing gate and license evidence
rules.ativo: never derived: requires revisado, trigger cases and a registry change with justification

localImports.families: creative video/3d tooling, device-specific checks, and product-local routers — counts and names omitted
